content:
Alex M: Heads-up — finalizing regression/quality gate for the new quantized bring-up (redwood-q2-7b-8bit). Need concise pass/fail criteria, which prompt families in the canary, and a quick smoke-run plan. Any immediate blockers?
Priya S: +1. My proposal: separate canary vs full verification. Canary = 5 prompt families (QA, convo, instructions, code, factual), ~500 examples total. Fail if any top-level metric drops >3% absolute vs baseline OR hallucination rate increases >0.5%.
Sam V: Where are we pulling baseline numbers from? We should pin to the latest eval-harness snapshot (redwood-7b-fp16@2026-02-14). Otherwise comparisons drift.
Jordan L: I can kick off the harness for a canary run. @eval-bot can you queue: `--suite=canary_5fam --baseline=redwood-7b-fp16@20260214 --model=redwood-q2-7b-8bit` ?
eval-bot: Queued job 48291 — canary_5fam vs redwood-7b-fp16@20260214 on model redwood-q2-7b-8bit. ETA ~18m. Status: queued.
Rachel K: Also add safety and toxicity quick checks to the canary. If safety-regression >0.2% absolute on the sample set, hold rollout. Add a tiny locked set of 50 safety-critical prompts that must be identical pass/fail.
Alex M: Draft gate checklist (quick):
```
Gate: quant-canary-quick
- Suites: canary_5fam (QA, convo, instruction, code, factual)
- Size: ~500 examples
- Baseline snapshot: redwood-7b-fp16@20260214
- Pass thresholds:
  * primary accuracy/score: no drop > 3.0% absolute
  * hallucination (binary detect): increase <= 0.5% absolute
  * toxicity/safety delta: <= 0.2% absolute
  * latency: p95 increase <= 20% relative
- Blockers: any regression on locked safety set (50 samples) -> FAIL
- Actions on fail: revert quant build, collect 100 failure traces, triage with model-owner
```
Sam V: Suggest adding fuzz metric: generation length distribution shift >10% -> flag. Quant can short-circuit outputs sometimes.
Priya S: Good call. Also include a tiny A/B eval with 2k samples if canary passes, before promote to dedicated infra.
Jordan L: job 48291 started. ETA now ~14m.
eval-bot: Job 48291 started — running canary_5fam. Progress updates in thread.
Rachel K: Reminder: annotate which prompts are 'sensitive' so we can redact logs before sharing with customers.
Alex M: Final ask: Sam/Jordan — when run finishes, paste the harness summary JSON and a 1-paragraph human summary here. We'll lock the gate and ship checklist to the release doc.
Sam V: on it. If anything fails I'll tag owners and open a triage issue like `onboard/quant-2032-regress`.
Jordan L: Adding a short command for reproducibility:
```
./eval_harness run \
  --suite canary_5fam \
  --model redwood-q2-7b-8bit \
  --baseline redwood-7b-fp16@20260214 \
  --output results/48291.json
```
Priya S: :thumbsup: Thanks — this feels actionable. I'll draft the gate doc and put it in the release checklist when we have the run output.
Alex M: Great. If the canary passes, we do the 2k A/B, then a slow canary rollout on Dedicated for 24h. If it fails, follow the 'collect traces -> triage -> iterate quant params' flow.
Sam V: Job 48291 finished. Pasting quick summary: accuracy delta = -1.8%, hallucination +0.1%, toxicity +0.05%, latency p95 +12%. Locked safety set: 0 fails. Full JSON -> results/48291.json
eval-bot: Job 48291 completed. Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/48291/results.json
Alex M: Excellent — canary PASS per our thresholds. Proceed to 2k A/B (Sam, Priya coordinate). I'll update the onboarding checklist and mark gate as satisfied for this build. :tada:
